# ASAM OpenCRG C library (vendored)

`inc/` and `src/` are the unmodified `c-api/baselib` of ASAM OpenCRG 2.0.0
(https://github.com/asam-ev/OpenCRG, commit a715b18a7aeef11b77c58ca68624be2ada3dec63),
Apache License 2.0 (`LICENSE`, `NOTICE`). FreeDyn 2.0 uses it to read and evaluate OpenCRG
road files (`runtime/src/crg.cpp`), so that roads are evaluated as the standard defines.
